verdict.rationale: Bevy offers in-depth reference docs with inline examples, a large browsable examples gallery, and community confirmation of 'lots of examples' (bevy-docs-27, bevy-docs-22, bevy-docs-34, bevy-comm-17). However, it is pre-1.0 with breaking changes each release, backed by migration guides and user reports of churn, so model-trained APIs often go stale; one user also calls the docs limited (bevy-probe-rt-1, bevy-docs-15, bevy-comm-10, bevy-comm-13, bevy-comm-14). Missing for 10: API stability across releases, evidence that LLM-generated code works first try, richer prose documentation, AI-oriented docs such as llms.txt.
